text: Martha set the loaf of bread on the shelf and went down to the well. While she was drawing water, a servant carried the bread to the cupboard. Martha knew nothing of it, and came up to cut a slice of bread.

text: Little Ned leaned his spade against the fence and ran off to chase a rabbit. A workman came by and stood the spade inside the shed. Ned did not see this happen. When he tired of the chase, Ned went back for his spade.

questions.q: Where will Ned look for his spade?
Where is the spade really?
